answer: A clock-skew attestation protocol curbs Sybil attacks by tracking quartz drift as temperatures fluctuate between their daily zenith and nadir. Verifiers check microsecond clock offsets to ensure each agent runs on dedicated silicon. To access this verified agent oasis, an attacker must operate distinct physical clock crystals per persona, incurring scarce hardware and electricity costs. However, adversaries using heated crystal ovens can synthesize artificial drift to spoof multiple identities.
